own_solution.law: Energy conservation gives Tf=(2×360+3×290)/(2+3)=318 K. For the isolated blocks, entropy generation equals their total entropy change: Sgen=900[2 ln(318/360)+3 ln(318/290)].
assumptions: The enclosure acts as an adiabatic boundary with negligible thermal storage.
The blocks exchange no work and undergo no phase changes.
The target is entropy generated during equilibration of the blocks.

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: T33C5 and TFF07 specify only a 'small amount', whereas the corresponding numerical variants specify 1.1 kg, so the variants do not preserve the required number and unit.

notes: The thermal calculation itself is well-posed under the usual insulated-enclosure idealization. For TC78D and T8625, the hotter mass becomes 3.1 kg at 360 K, giving Tf=325.5737705 K and Sgen=900[3.1 ln(Tf/360)+3 ln(Tf/290)]=31.9753 J/K. Earlier-run quantities have no effect on this run, and material in the thermally disconnected mould has no effect on the blocks' equilibration. The unspecified amounts in T33C5 and TFF07 therefore do not prevent numerical answers, but they violate the required matching of quantities across variants.
